scripts.build:css:bundle: cat assets/css/chunks/*.css assets/css/deferred.css assets/css/site.css assets/css/brand.css > assets/css/bundle.css
scripts.build:css: npm run build:css:bundle && npm run build:css:critical && postcss assets/css/**/*.css --dir dist/css --env production
scripts.deploy:lambda-edge: cd lambda-edge && npm install && zip -r ../lambda-edge-inject-css.zip . && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name inject-critical-css --zip-file fileb://../lambda-edge-inject-css.zip
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:css:purge
scripts.deploy:s3: aws s3 sync dist/css s3://${S3_BUCKET}/css --cache-control max-age=31536000 --metadata-directive REPLACE
